h: VeryDarkMan shares school renovation reportedly funded by Burna Boy, answers critics
p: VeryDarkMan has posted a video of a school renovation project said to have been paid for by Burna Boy and used the post to respond to critics. The video has fuelled fresh talk about his ties with the singer and the Davido rivalry.
more: Fans are split over the back-and-forth online.
Commentators say the project is drawing more attention than the feud.

Burna Boy in tinted glasses and a patterned cardigan
